name: OLED Black
description: True black for OLED screens, with Tailwind CSS cyan and purple accents. Dark only.

provenance.attribution: Tailwind Labs, Inc., Tailwind CSS v3.4.17's cyan-300 and purple-400, under the MIT License.
provenance.derivation: anchor-v1 from the reviewed prototype's oled-black anchors: a black canvas and #f5f5f2 text, with Tailwind CSS v3.4.17 cyan-300 as the accent and purple-400 as the secondary.

fallbacks: Every display mode renders the dark set, high contrast renders the sets high-contrast-v1 derives from it, and print renders the light high-contrast set, since print is always light.
caveats: Dark only: it keeps its native dark mode, so light isn't offered with it.
